assign.request: Build a TABBED CARD on the AI 2 card page: Overview (what it is, state, refined summary) and Tasks (sub-cards as the table of contents, grouped under headings by a `group` line appended to each sub-card). Vocabulary card / request / task. Reuse ext/tabs, remember the open tab per card. Full ask in requirements.md.
steps: Read card.js, ext/tabs, groups.js and the Cards fold
Append the group lines to the Dictate card's requests
Tabs + grouped request list in card.js
Headless screenshots 1920 / 3440 / 390, both tabs, zero console errors

log.msg: Skipped the usage refresh: my fence does not name ai/usage.json or usage.jsonl.

Appended {"group": ...} to all 13 requests of 2026/09/24/prompt-mechanics-2 with append.mjs (Dictation box 6, Chat layout 3, Chat messages 4). No folder was missing. Line 1, ids and folders untouched. The ai2 readme says only Servex writes card folders; the owner's spec asked for this append, so it was done by the append helper, not by hand.

decision.question: How to reuse ext/tabs on a card?
options: Page.tabs() - routes each tab to a child url
Wear ext/tabs' classes (.tabs .tab-bar .tab .tab-panel) and switch in card.js
decision.chose: Wear the classes; switch in card.js
decision.why: Page.tabs() makes every tab a child url, and a card's children are its requests, so a 'tasks/' url would be read as a request folder. The classes give the exact same look and the selected mark with no routing.

decision.question: Tab labels and list words
options: Overview / Tasks, the list inside headed 'N requests'
decision.chose: Overview / Tasks · 13; the list says '13 requests' and '+ request'; the composer says 'talk into this request'
decision.why: The owner named the tab Tasks; the tab also holds the agents' task pages (what agents do), so Tasks is accurate, and the rows inside are requests.

decision.question: Where does the group of each request come from?
options: Servex /card fold for each request (needs Servex)
Load every request as a live Page (13 live streams)
Fetch each request's page.jsonl once and read its last {group} line
decision.chose: Fetch each page.jsonl, re-read on every visit to the card
decision.why: Works with Servex down and on the static site, costs one small fetch per request, and never opens 13 live streams. Caveat: a group line written while the card is open shows on the next visit, not live.

decision.question: Group order
options: Order each group first appears among the requests
decision.chose: First appearance; ungrouped last as Other
decision.why: Deterministic from the data alone, with no extra config. Chat layout comes first for Dictate because its first request is the oldest.

log.msg: Fixed on the way: a {"type": "refined"} line (Servex Layers.amend_bubble) would have gone through core set() and turned the card's type into 'refined' and overwritten its text and by. Card.set() now keeps it whole as the summary.

3440 first shot: one 1780px-wide request list and the summary ran 1770px wide, because ext/tabs sets --measure: none on every panel. Fixed: groups are grid columns (auto-fill, min 26em: 1 column at 1920 and 390, 3 at 3440) and the card's panel restores --measure: inherit.

Verified headless (Playwright, monorepo.localhost): Dictate card at 1920, 3440, 390 on both tabs; 3 group headings and 13 rows on Tasks; clicking a tab switches it and a reload keeps it; opening a request still shows the third column (875px), its own chat (437px, 'talk into this request') and 5 resize grips; zero console errors, zero failed requests. Shots in shots/.

assign.outcome:
**A top-level card on AI 2 now has two tabs, Overview and Tasks, and the Tasks tab groups its requests under headings.** On the [Dictate card](/framework/ai2/2026/09/24/prompt-mechanics-2/) the 13 requests sit under Chat layout, Dictation box and Chat messages. At 3440 the three groups sit side by side as columns.

![Tasks tab at 3440](/framework/ai/2026-09-25/tabbed-card/shots/tabbed-card-3440-tasks.png)

- **Overview** shows what the card is, its bar and cost, its summary (the latest refined reading, else the first thing you said), and a line such as "13 requests, 0 done - see Tasks".
- **Tasks** shows the requests and, below them, the agents' task pages. The tab you last opened is remembered for each card.
- The words on screen are now *card*, *request* and *task*: "+ request", "13 requests", "talk into this request".
- A request is grouped by one `{"group": "..."}` line appended to its own log; with no groups the list stays flat.
- The chat column, the third column that opens a request, and the resize handles all work as before.

Fixed on the way: a refined-summary line would have turned a card's type into "refined"; it is now kept as the summary.

Code: [card.js](/framework/ai2/card.js) - [ai2.css](/framework/ai2/ai2.css) - docs: [AI 2 card doc](/framework/ai2/doc/cards/).

Left as it is: a group line written while a card is open shows on your next visit, not live.
